# LASALLE BIONATIONAL PHARMACY [italic]Trusted medicine for the frontier. The standard stock of every Lasalle dispensary, from Gateway to the Outer Veil.[/italic]
## WELCOME Lasalle Bionational has supplied medicine to the colonies for more than sixty years. Under the frontier clinic agreement, every chartered colony with a clinic carries the Lasalle standard stock list, so the bottle you are given on {colony} is the same bottle, with the same label and the same dose, as the one you would be given on Gateway or Mars.
This site gives product information for colonists. It is not a substitute for your colony clinician. If you are hurt or unwell, go to the clinic. If you cannot get to the clinic, call for the clinic to come to you.
## OUR MEDICINES - [netlink="Tablets: the pill bottle range" link="pharmacy.lasalle.bio/tablets"] - [netlink="Autoinjectors: fast help when it matters" link="pharmacy.lasalle.bio/injectors"] - [netlink="Prescriptions, opening hours and dispensary rules" link="pharmacy.lasalle.bio/prescriptions"] - [netlink="Your colony clinic dispensary" link="dispensary.colony.med"]
## THE COLOUR CODE Every Lasalle pill bottle is colour coded so that it can be recognised in poor light, in a hurry or through a fogged visor. - [color=#B02020][bold]Red[/bold][/color]: bruises, cuts and blunt injuries. - [color=#9A7A00][bold]Yellow[/bold][/color]: burns. - [color=#2E8A3E][bold]Green[/bold][/color]: poisoning and toxins. - [color=#1B5FA8][bold]Blue[/bold][/color]: breathing and oxygen. - [color=#7A4AA0][bold]Purple[/bold][/color]: stabilising a patient in a bad way. - [color=#C06010][bold]Orange[/bold][/color]: general first aid.
## A NOTE ON SAFETY Every Lasalle medicine is safe at the labelled dose and harmful above it. Read the label. Never take a second dose sooner than the label allows. Never take somebody else's prescription. Keep every bottle out of the reach of children and away from the galley.
[color=#5A7078]Lasalle Bionational. Better medicine for better worlds. Product information only. Lasalle Bionational is a partner of the Weyland-Yutani Colonial Development Division under the frontier clinic agreement.[/color]
